intro: Ngingumakhi wetinhlelo losacala. Ngiphatsa lusito lwekugcina emaseva ASHIKA Network kanye neluhla lwemaseva aMinecraft SABALISU, futsi ngakha luhlelo lweseva yaMinecraft Storia.
about: Ngisesemusha, kodvwa ngibhala ikhodi onkhe malanga futsi ngiyatfutfuka
Imibuto ngetinsita tami nobe ngebuchwepheshe yemukelekile: vele ungibingelele ku-Discord
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: emaseva kusukela ku-yen lengu-30 ngenyanga
anw_p:
Lusito lwekugcina labo labafuna kusebentisa iseva kodvwa labangakhoni kusebentisa imali lenyenti.
Cala kancane, **kusukela ku-yen lengu-30 kuphela ngenyanga**.
sab_p:
Faka iseva yakho yaMinecraft eluhlwini bese utfola bantfu labatawudlala kuyo.
Kuyasita kubadlali labafuna iseva kanye nebanikati labafuna kwatisa leyabo.
storia_t: Storia: luhlelo lweseva lwemaseva lamakhulu aMinecraft
storia_p: I-fork yemtfombo levulekile ye-Folia ye-Minecraft 26.2. Nge-**Storia Cluster**, live linye lingasebenta ematseveni lamanyenti ngesikhatsi sinye, futsi badlali bayashintja emkhatsini wawo ngaphandle kwesikrini sekulayisha.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: live linye lelabelwana ngemaseva lamanyenti, linetichumanisi letifihliwe
**Relay lelindzile**: relay lesibili ligcina likhophi lelisaphila futsi lingena esikhundleni salokucala uma lilahlekile
**Sakhiwo se-Linear**: live litsatsa cishe ingcenye yendzawo kudiski
**Live ku-RAM**, **Tick Guard**, i-API ye-plugin yemininingwane lelabelwanako, nalokunye
